svg.title: Nuclear power plant — Kjarnorkuver
svg.desc: A domed containment encloses a fuel-rod reactor vessel and connects by pipe to an adjacent turbine hall.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"power-nuclear-plant","label_en":"Nuclear power plant","label_is":"Kjarnorkuver","section":"06","category_en":"Power plants and generation","category_is":"Orkuver og orkuframleiðsla","batch":3,"tags":["power","nuclear"],"description":"A domed containment encloses a fuel-rod reactor vessel and connects by pipe to an adjacent turbine hall.","design_note":"Visible containment, an internal fuel-rod vessel and connected hall identify nuclear generation without relying on a generic cooling tower.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
